_about: The budgets section Django pushes after the Budgets page's Set Budget dialog, case by case. futureagi/agentcc/tests/test_budget_push.py posts each case's dialog bodies to the real set-budget view and asserts the push equals the case's value here; plugins/budget/budget_console_test.go decodes the same value through the generated admin contract (unknown fields refused) and runs the budget plugin on it. Edit both together.
